title: IGNITE 2018
summary: Six focus areas, from engineering to scholarships.
body:
IGNITE 2018 covered six areas: engineering and entrance examinations; medicine and allied healthcare; pure sciences, agriculture and veterinary science; government jobs and defence; time management; and scholarships and financial aid.

Sessions were kept to 20–30 minutes and run interactively, with a handout after each one, and senior alumni joined for sessions where they could. A separate programme ran for Class 10 students on the choices open after the 10th, and on the soft skills that go with them.
